contour_fit.policy: Retain qualified v2 fixed reference; for each nonempty subset of reliable upper groups, greedily place<=8 linear amplitude knots>=10ms apart, two amplitude-shape/spectral alternations. Fit/score normalized curves weighted by inverse max(v2 band RMSE,.05). Select lowest qualified score; original six spectral gates and per-band nonregression vs original band-attack entry unchanged. No extra runtime component or parameter capacity.
contour_fit.limitations: Time-shape tradeoffs against v2 remain possible and are reported per band. Only two upper groups, one fit seed and one crop; no mechanical timbre or source-separation claim. Coarse energy controls do not contain PCM, audio-rate envelopes or full fine structure.

reference_fit.policy: Only upper bands with >=3dB mean band event/background contrast receive8 coarse knots. Fit mean-normalized power-curve shape, then unit-amplitude existing-component finite-response gains; two bounded alternations, choose qualified lowest shape error. Original six spectral gates and per-selected-band temporal nonregression both required.
reference_fit.limitations: A low-contrast band keeps its original local envelopes, not an inferred silent or isolated source. Spectral positive-bin excess and band-total temporal excess differ; shape fitting does not treat them as identical energy targets. One fit seed/crop does not establish naturalness, physical RPM or source identity. Runtime components/counts remain unchanged.
